BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to antifreeze products; and amending RCW 19.94.544.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.94.544 and 2008 c 68 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The requirements of this section and RCW 19.94.540 and 19.94.542shall not apply to: (1) The sale of a motor vehicle that containsengine coolant or antifreeze ((or to wholesale containers of fiftyfivegallons or more of engine coolant or antifreeze)); or (2) spent enginecoolant or spent antifreeze being stored or transported for disposal inaccordance with chapter 70.105 RCW.
